Description.Name: Ruby
Description.Details: Ruby Rhod is a famous host of a 2 hour radio show hosted on and sponsored by the travel company Fhloston Paradise, with over fifty billion people of The Federated Commonwealth's population listening to his show. He has very unorthodox wardrobe and exotic fashion sense. In many ways, he acts in a girlish manner when exposed to combat or is simply annoyed by your presence.
